mapper.select: SELECT token_id , user_id , token_type , token_value , expires_at , used_at , created_at FROM auth_tokens WHERE token_value = #{tokenValue} AND token_type = #{tokenType} AND used_at IS NULL AND expires_at > NOW()
mapper.update: UPDATE auth_tokens SET used_at = NOW() WHERE token_id = #{tokenId} AND used_at IS NULL
